module: Visualizes the shared wind field: samples `be:getWindAt()` on a 21 x 21 grid of points spaced 5 m apart centered on the camera, and draws one arrow per point (direction = wind, length and color = speed, from blue to red at 20 m/s). Text in the center shows the wind speed in m/s and km/h. Gusts are animated because the field varies over time.
notes: Disabled by default (enabled = false); draws only if enabled is true.
The arrows are placed 1 m above the terrain (core_terrain.getTerrainHeight) or 2 m below the camera if the terrain is not available.
Cells where the wind is below 0.05 m/s are not drawn. Arrow length: 0.15 m per m/s, capped at 4.5 m.

enabled.desc: True when the wind visualization is active.

onPreRender.desc: Pre-render hook: if enabled, draws the grid of wind arrows around the camera and the speed text in the center.

v.desc: any value; converted to a boolean (true if truthy)
